Strategy: Prefer either very tight or very roomy bins and avoid the middle, scoring tight residuals by Best Fit and roomy ones by closeness to ninety. This tests whether middle residuals are the real waste, but it may prefer roomy bins that Best Fit would avoid and waste space.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) if r - item <= 45 else (r - item - 90)) for r in bins]
```
